source.description: sys.argv[1] assigned to `root` without normalisation, restriction, or existence check

hops.note: `root` passed as argument to scan(); no sanitisation applied before or at the call site
`root` used directly as the top-level argument to os.walk(); no path normalisation or containment check
`path` constructed via os.path.join(base, name) from os.walk output; value inherits traversal scope of `root`

sink.description: open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') reads arbitrary files reachable from the user-supplied root; enables unauthorised disclosure of files outside the intended source tree

sanitisationGaps.description: No os.path.realpath/abspath normalisation or prefix containment check applied to sys.argv[1] before use as root
Directory blocklist ({'.git','node_modules','build','target'}) only filters named subdirectories; does not constrain root from pointing outside the intended source tree

source.description: Messages from the external `aurora.telemetry.tenant` bus topic are received in consume() via bus.subscribe(); message.body originates from tenant systems outside the service trust boundary

hops.note: consume() iterates over bus messages from TENANT_TOPIC; each message (including its .body) is forwarded to handle() at line 13. bus.subscribe is unresolved in the link graph (opaque parameter), but the data flow within this file is unambiguous.
handle() receives the full message object; message.body carries the untrusted bus payload with no sanitisation, filtering, or schema validation before the next hop

sink.description: yaml.load(message.body) called without a Loader argument; PyYAML default Loader supports !!python/object/apply and related tags, allowing a malicious bus publisher to achieve arbitrary Python code execution in the consumer process

owaspCategory: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures
severityUpgradeReason: No crossComponent:true hops present in the Link Graph for this chain; bus.subscribe is an open end (producer component not yet delivered) rather than a resolved cross-component seam, so the severity upgrade rule does not apply

sanitisationGaps.description: yaml.load() called with no Loader; should be yaml.safe_load() or yaml.load(..., Loader=yaml.SafeLoader) to prevent arbitrary object instantiation from attacker-controlled bus messages
No schema validation, type checking, or size limit applied to message.body before passing it to the deserialiser
